SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `base_variants` INNER JOIN `variant_categories` ON `base_variants`.`variant_category_id` = `variant_categories`.`id` WHERE `base_variants`.`type` = 'Variant' AND `variant_categories`.`link_id` = 22 AND `variant_categories`.`deleted_at` IS NULL AND `variant_categories`.`title` = 'Tier' AND `base_variants`.`deleted_at` IS NULL
SELECT `base_variants`.* FROM `base_variants` WHERE `base_variants`.`id` = 21 LIMIT 1
SELECT `base_variants`.`sales_count_for_inventory_cache` FROM `base_variants` WHERE `base_variants`.`type` = 'Sku' AND `base_variants`.`id` = 21 LIMIT 1
